original.statement: urllib3 dependency bumped from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 in the /hack/api-docs documentation tooling.

decision.reason: [ev-bd0683c222ce] only says that dependabot bumped urllib3 from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 under /hack/api-docs. That is the repository's API-docs generation tooling, not something the deployed external-secrets product depends on or interacts with. Treating it as a product-relationship subject misreads where the change sits, and no other subject family fits an internal docs-build dependency. The validators were inconclusive and do not support the assertion either.
